Director, Product Design — Core Platform

We're looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our platform design team. You will inherit a team of five product designers and one content designer, with headcount to grow the team next year.

What you'll do:
- Mentor and coach designers through weekly 1:1s, design critiques, and career development plans; you will be the performance manager for your team, including hiring, feedback, and promotion cases.
- Raise the bar on craft across the team: run critique, develop designers' judgment, and teach through hands-on design reviews.
- Steward our mature design system alongside the platform team that builds it and the product teams that use it.
- Own the design direction for one product area over the long term — we ship, learn, and continuously improve the same product year over year.
- Partner with a design-fluent CPO who ran product design orgs herself; design has a permanent seat in product planning, its own budget, and dedicated research support.
- Stay hands-on where it matters: you'll be in Figma weekly for reviews and occasional key flows, not production work.

About you:
- You've led and grown design teams of 4-8 at established product companies.
- You care about developing designers as much as shipping product.
- You think in systems and teach others to.

We offer flexible hours, an async-first culture, and explicit work-life boundaries. Fully remote within the United States.
